message: 僕だけが除け者!?

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Where's Nanaka?」

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee」

name: Synn
message: 「Takahashi? Oh, she went to Sacchin's house」

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. I didn't come to eat today--」
Feeling like we made eye contact, I looked over and,
『Synn-kun. Stay and eat』
『Huh, are you sure? I always feel bad imposing』
『Show Synn-kun to his usual seat』

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee!」
It seems the old man's will gets through to Tinun, too.
Taking the seat I was shown to, I made contact again.
『It seems like Nanaka's been staying up late a lot lately, though』
Huh?
『Old man? It seems like Nanaka's been staying up late a lot lately』
Huh-uh?
I'm not getting through!
The quiet old man has actually gone completely silent!
『Um, are her assignments really that tough?』
『O-oh, yeah, her assignments are tough, Synn-kun. It's the assignments, the assignments』
Oh, I got through. Still.
『Is that really all?』
Huh? Huh-uh?
Disconnected again?

name: Paqy
message: 「He's definitely hiding somethin'」
Her mom talked about plenty of stuff too, but she dodged around the important parts...

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka probably swore them to secrecy」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why don'tcha try askin' Aunt Shina or someone」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if she knows, she'd probably spill everything--both what's true and what isn't--but」

name: Synn
message: 「If she doesn't know, she might just tail Nanaka from morning till night to investigate」

name: Paqy
message: 「That'd be a disaster for Soba」

name: Synn
message: 「Which is why I can't ask her」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Sakura-san. Hello」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Fuyuka-san, hello」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「You aren't with Nanaka-san today?」

name: Synn
message: 「We aren't together all the time」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「How have things been with Nanaka-san since then?」

name: Synn
message: 「How, you ask?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I see. No wonder Nanaka-san is working so hard」

name: Synn
message: 「Working hard at what--」
Ah.

name: Synn
message: 「You know! What Nanaka is doing right now!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「I wouldn't know」

name: Synn
message: 「You just said she's working hard, didn't you」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Whatever could you mean?」
Another wall of secrecy here too!

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, Nanaka and the others came to tour Chocolat's kitchen before, right?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes. That was quite fun」

name: Synn
message: 「That has something to do with what Nanaka is doing right now, doesn't it?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Unfortunately, I truly do not know what Nanaka-san is currently up to」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Besides, even if I did know, I couldn't possibly tell you」
Tight-lipped. More importantly, I have way too little to go on!

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Now then, I must get back to the shop, so I'll take my leave here」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Give my regards to Nanaka-san」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if Nanaka's secret has something to do with sweets...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「And anyway, if it's tied to the Holy Night Festival, you'll find out whether you like it or not once the day comes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that really... all there is to it?」
That's it! Speaking of someone who's fairly close to Nanaka and has enough free time to give advice about the Holy Night Festival!

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「So she's been staying up late all the time? I see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's right. I want to get her to stop, but I don't know how...」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Kimigahara--no, it seems I won't be of much help to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, were you just about to say something?」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「She comes by to eat, so I'll tell her not to stay up so late.」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Okay...」
He knows something too! No doubt about it!
And there's no doubt he's not going to spill it either!

name: Synn
message: 「Do you really not know anything? Apparently, she's staying up late over something related to sweets.」

name: Tanimura-san
message: 「Even if that's the case, she knows plenty of people in the sweets business. She wouldn't go out of her way to consult me.」
A vague sense of being left out.
